info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Validation API

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Document Understanding project

params.name: api-version
params.description: API version to use for this request

items.docs: Submits digitization, classification, and extraction results for asynchronous validation. Validation checks the accuracy of previously processed results and may invoke human-in-the-loop review for low-confidence extractions. Returns a requestId for polling.
